title: Choose the new Warcode look
question: Choose the direction to carry into Warcode. The previews use illustrative coding content.

options.label: Control room
options.thesis: A graphite coding workspace with amber actions and clear change review.
options.viewport: Project navigation on the left, conversation in the center, and file changes on the right.
options.risk: Amber must stay reserved for actions to keep the workspace calm.

raised.raise: Session activity stays attached to its row.
Consistent spacing carries dense settings and the main session.
Code and status use aligned values and readable contrast.
Secondary actions stay beside their content.

options.label: Workroom
options.thesis: A warm light coding workspace with ink typography and orange actions.
options.viewport: A quiet session list frames a spacious conversation and file review.
options.risk: Its layout is familiar, with character carried by typography and color.

options.label: Data field
options.risk: Strict monochrome scanning competes with syntax and conversation.
options.case: Strict monochrome scanning competes with syntax and conversation.

options.label: Gate board
options.risk: Time-ranked travel semantics obscure project navigation.
options.case: Time-ranked travel semantics obscure project navigation.

options.label: Dense utility
options.thesis: A dense module grid of coding controls
options.viewport: A dense module grid of coding controls
options.risk: A mosaic leaves too little room for sustained reading and review.
options.case: A mosaic leaves too little room for sustained reading and review.

options.label: Catalog wall
options.risk: Artwork adds little to the existing coding workflow.
options.case: Artwork adds little to the existing coding workflow.

options.label: Reference manual
options.risk: Layering adds an indirect metaphor to direct coding tasks.
options.case: Layering adds an indirect metaphor to direct coding tasks.

options.label: Transit diagram
options.risk: Route metaphors obscure files and conversation state.
options.case: Route metaphors obscure files and conversation state.

canonCard.label: Familiar editor
canonCard.thesis: A conventional dark coding workspace with blue actions.
canonCard.viewport: A project sidebar, conversation, and changes panel.
canonCard.risk: It will resemble other coding editors.
